title: Minimum Cost to Connect All Points
description: You are given an array `points` representing integer coordinates of points on a 2D-plane. The cost of connecting two points `(x_i, y_i)` and `(x_j, y_j)` is Manhattan distance `|x_i - x_j| + |y_i - y_j|`. Return the minimum cost to make all points connected.
input_format: First line contains `n`. Following `n` lines contain `x` and `y`.
hints: This is a Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) problem on a complete graph.
Prim's algorithm with a priority queue finds the MST in O(N^2) or O(N log N).
Track the minimum Manhattan distance to add each unvisited point.
